text:
**Date:** 14 March 2031, when the depot site was formally announced.
**Named person:** Maren Tolliver, Chief Infrastructure Officer of Kestrelline Rail, confirmed the Port Ansgar location.
**Figure:** The depot is budgeted at 412 million credits and will employ 1,150 staff once operational.
**Source document:** The Kestrelline Rail Fleet Maintenance Expansion Plan, released at the company's spring investor briefing.
